name: Floor Area Ratio
summary: Total gross floor area divided by site area. Primary control on intensity of development.

name: Dwellings per Hectare
summary: Net dwelling density. Suburban ~25, urban neighbourhood ~75-150, urban core ~300+.

name: Walk Score
summary: Distance-decay-weighted index of amenity proximity. >=70 'very walkable', >=90 'walker's paradise'.

name: Height-to-Width Ratio
summary: Building height divided by street width. Comfortable enclosure ~0.5-2.0; canyon effects beyond 2.0.

name: Active Frontage Percentage
summary: Share of ground floor with doors, windows, transparency, and activity. Vibrant streets >=70%.

name: Tree Canopy Cover
summary: Share of urban surface beneath tree canopy. Healthy cities >=30%; Singapore Garden City target 40%.

name: Walking Mode Share
summary: Share of trips made on foot. Compact mixed-use districts: 30-50%; auto-dependent suburbs: <10%.

name: Cycling Mode Share
summary: Share of trips made by bicycle. Copenhagen 49%, Amsterdam 36%, US median <2%.

name: Thermal Transmittance (U-value)
summary: Heat transfer per unit area per degree. Passive House wall <=0.15; typical UK Building Regs cap 0.18-0.30.

name: Daylight Factor
summary: Internal illuminance / external diffuse illuminance × 100. Habitable rooms target >=2%.

name: Reverberation Time (RT60)
summary: Time for sound to decay by 60 dB. Speech intelligibility 0.6-0.9s; concert hall 1.8-2.2s.

name: Embodied Carbon Intensity
summary: Cradle-to-practical-completion carbon (LCA stages A1-A5) per GFA. RIBA 2030 office target <=625; LETI 2030 <=350.

name: Energy Use Intensity
summary: Annual delivered energy per GFA. LETI 2030 office target <=55; UK existing office median ~150.
